name: mcp.terminal
rests_on: agents-terminal jailed CLI. commands_from help-json publishes each command's side_effects. A declared command is invoked as itself. Other argv is run -- <command>. exit 0 = present

argv.description: Argv. When argv[0] is a command declared by this tool's help-json, that command's side_effects, mutates, or annotations.readOnlyHint decide the approval class and the argv is passed through. Otherwise the argv runs under the mutating run command (e.g. ["echo", "hi"]).

command.description: Either the exact name of a declared help-json command, or a shell command line to run (e.g. 'git status'). A shell line is mutating.

command_name.description: Declared help-json command name. Side effects come from that command's metadata, not from the name.
